LESSON: LISHE BORA

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.23: Lishe Bora

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Lishe Bora. Soma kwa makini, angalia mifano, kisha fanya mazoezi na jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kutambua msamiati kuhusu lishe bora ili kuimarisha mawasiliano
2. kusoma maneno yanayohusiana na lishe bora ili kuimarisha usomaji
3. kuandika maneno yanayohusu lishe bora katika kuimarisha uandishi bora
4. kutumia msamiati ulisomwa katika kutunga sentensi ili kuimarisha mawasiliano e) kuthamini kula chakula kinachofaidi mwili ili kujikinga kutokana na madhara ya ukosefu wa lishe bora. Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza: Masimulizi (Vipindi 2) kuzungumza
5. kuzungumzia juu ya chakula anachokipenda ili kuimarisha mazungumzo 68
6. kuzungumzia juu ya chakula kinachodhuru afya ili kuelewa madhara ya vyakula hivyo

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kutambua msamiati kuhusu lishe bora ili kuimarisha mawasiliano
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to kutambua msamiati kuhusu lishe bora ili kuimarisha mawasiliano. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. kusoma maneno yanayohusiana na lishe bora ili kuimarisha usomaji
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to kusoma maneno yanayohusiana na lishe bora ili kuimarisha usomaji. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. kuandika maneno yanayohusu lishe bora katika kuimarisha uandishi bora
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to kuandika maneno yanayohusu lishe bora katika kuimarisha uandishi bora. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

4. kutumia msamiati ulisomwa katika kutunga sentensi ili kuimarisha mawasiliano e) kuthamini kula chakula kinachofaidi mwili ili kujikinga kutokana na madhara ya ukosefu wa lishe bora. Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza: Masimulizi (Vipindi 2) kuzungumza
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to kutumia msamiati ulisomwa katika kutunga sentensi ili kuimarisha mawasiliano e) kuthamini kula chakula kinachofaidi mwili ili kujikinga kutokana na madhara ya ukosefu wa lishe bora. Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza: Masimulizi (Vipindi 2) kuzungumza. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

5. kuzungumzia juu ya chakula anachokipenda ili kuimarisha mazungumzo 68
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to kuzungumzia juu ya chakula anachokipenda ili kuimarisha mazungumzo 68. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

6. kuzungumzia juu ya chakula kinachodhuru afya ili kuelewa madhara ya vyakula hivyo
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to kuzungumzia juu ya chakula kinachodhuru afya ili kuelewa madhara ya vyakula hivyo. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Mfano 1: Asubuhi shuleni, salimu mwalimu: “Shikamoo.” Mwalimu atasema: “Marahaba.”

Mfano 2: Sikiliza hadithi fupi kisha mweleze rafiki yako jambo moja ulilosikia.

Mfano 3: Andika sentensi tatu kuhusu familia yako ukitumia maneno mapya.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Lishe Bora.
2. Explain Lishe Bora to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Lishe Bora.
4. Show that you can: kutambua msamiati kuhusu lishe bora ili kuimarisha mawasiliano
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA (MAZOEZI / MAREKEBISHO)

1. Write five sentences about Lishe Bora. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Lishe Bora important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU 8: KUMBUKA

1. kutambua msamiati kuhusu lishe bora ili kuimarisha mawasiliano
2. kusoma maneno yanayohusiana na lishe bora ili kuimarisha usomaji
3. kuandika maneno yanayohusu lishe bora katika kuimarisha uandishi bora
4. kutumia msamiati ulisomwa katika kutunga sentensi ili kuimarisha mawasiliano e) kuthamini kula chakula kinachofaidi mwili ili kujikinga kutokana na madhara ya ukosefu wa lishe bora. Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza: Masimulizi (Vipindi 2) kuzungumza

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.
